newsitem.title: FRANCE: French local authorities to break even in 1997.
newsitem.headline: French local authorities to break even in 1997.

text.p: French local authorities will break even in 1997 after showing a deficit amounting to 0.05 percent of gross domestic product in 1996, a government budget document said.
Local authorities posted a deficit amounting to 0.2 percent of gross domestic product in 1995.
The document said a marked slowdown in spending would help bring the deficit "close to equilibrium" in 1996.
The document attributed most of the slowdown in spending to the impact of the index freeze on wages and a reduction in financial charges brought about by interest rate reductions.
It also said local authority tax receipts had remained relative dynamic despite the economic slowdown because they were based on variables not that dependent on the immediate economic environment.
